text:
Chris: Hey team — we need to lock a time for the postmortem on the 2026-03-04 infra blip. Proposed slots: Wed 11:00 PT or Thu 15:00 PT. Who should definitely attend? I think eng-runtime, eng-sre, the incident owner, and product. Draft notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/posts/pm-20260304-draft :calendar:

Maya: Wed 11 works for me. Can we keep it to 45m and focus on timeline + actions?

Alex: Thu 15 is better for my calendar. If Wed is preferred, I can do the first 30.

Sanjay: Eng-SRE will join. Please add latency/throughput graphs to the doc — I'll bring the mitigations timeline.

Emily: Product needs rollout impact + affected customer list. Thu 15 would be better for us.

Chris: Sounds like split availability. Proposal: do a core 45m session Wed 11 for eng/runtime/SRE (required) and an optional 30m follow-up Thu 15 for product + customers. I'll create two events and mark required/optional accordingly. :thumbsup:

pm-bot: Postmortem doc created at https://docs.redwood.ai/posts/pm-20260304-draft — please update 'Timeline' and 'Actions' sections before the Wed core session.

Alex: I'll update the Timeline by EOD Tue. @Sanjay can you add the graphs? @Maya can you draft the initial actions list?

Maya: Yup, will add actions + blockers. Suggesting an agenda layout we should follow in both sessions:
```
1) Quick timeline (10m)
2) RCA: what failed & why (10m)
3) Short-term mitigations (10m)
4) Long-term actions + owners (10m)
5) Confirm next steps & owners (5m)
```

Chris: Good structure. We'll aim to cover items 1-3 in the core session and reserve 4-5 for the follow-up if product/customer questions require extra time. Required attendees for Wed core: Chris, Maya, Alex, Sanjay, incident owner. Optional for Thu: Emily, Support lead, Legal if needed.

Sanjay: Quick ask — can the runbook author attend? I'll DM them.

Alex: Added incident owner and runbook link to the doc. Also pasted the key logs snippet under Timeline.

Chris: Action summary so far: Alex -> Timeline update; Maya -> Actions + blockers; Sanjay -> Metrics graphs & mitigations timeline; Chris -> Calendar invites + doc housekeeping. Everyone: add artifacts (logs, dashboards, runbook links) to the doc by Tue 17:00 PT. If anything is missing, flag it in the doc

Emily: Noted — I'll attach customer list + comms timeline by Tue.

Chris: Thanks. I'll send invites now and mark the two sessions in calendar. If anyone can't make the core session but must be consulted, please mark as required on the doc or ping me directly. :email:

pm-bot: Calendar invites sent to required/optional attendee lists.
